sources.title: Transactions · synthetic lesson
sources.text: A database transaction preserves consistency. Atomicity means all operations complete or none do. A stack removes the most recently added item first. A queue removes the earliest added item first.

questions.prompt: What does a database transaction preserve?
questions.explanation: The lesson explicitly states that a transaction preserves consistency.

questions.answer: All operations complete or none do.
questions.explanation: Atomicity treats the operations as one unit.
